body: From tackling personal decisions to reaching important milestones, my job is to guide you on the path of sustainability towards success. I have PhD in Biology and more than 30 years of experience in progressively senior levels of responsibility at universities and international environmental organizations. As a professional Senior Environmental Consultant, I’m offering services in leading environmental non-profits, programme and project management and environmental research. I’m fueled by my commitment to excellence and go the extra mile to make sure clients are fully satisfied with my work. Get in touch with me today for a free consultation.

recommendations.author: Nela Jović, Senior Programme Advisor at the Royal Norwegian Embassy in Belgrade
recommendations.summary: Radoje has excellent coordination and communication skills, and he was instrumental in attracting other donors to join the effort of creating larger and lasting impact.
recommendations.body: I know Radoje for quite some time. He was my teaching assistant during my study at the Faculty of Biology. Then we cooperated when I was working for Sida - he was a regional director of REC and this organization implemented project of Swedish support to environmental civil society organizations in the WB region. Most recently, I had the pleasure of working with Radoje during the implementation of the Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center 'Boka Aquarium' (MonteAqua) project, funded by the Norwegian Embassy in Belgrade and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development of Montenegro. As project manager, Radoje demonstrated strong leadership, ensuring achieving the agreed objectives. Under this project, the first public aquarium in Montenegro was established, along with a rescue center for endangered marine animals, contributing to both biodiversity conservation and tourism development. Radoje has excellent coordination and communication skills, and he was instrumental in attracting other donors to join the effort of creating larger and lasting impact. I highly recommend Radoje for any future environmental and marine conservation endeavors.
